telegramInstance.label: Telegram instance
telegramInstance.help: The telegram.0 instance telegrammenu2 sends/receives through (communicate.request).

javascriptInstance.label: JavaScript instance (for script bridge)
javascriptInstance.help: The instance your Telegram scripts run under (for the script bridge / onMessage calls).

scriptFolder.label: Script folder (for short script names)
scriptFolder.help: If you only enter a short name in the editor tab (e.g. "myScript" instead of "script.js.Telegram.myScript"), this folder is prepended automatically.

_note.text: Menu import currently works via sendTo('telegrammenu2.0', 'importRegistry', <JSON>) - a dedicated import button here is planned.
